description: This file defines the GatewayConnectChallengeSupport enum containing static functions to handle nonce extraction from payloads and to wait asynchronously for a nonce with a timeout mechanism.

methods.name: nonce(from:)
methods.description: Extracts and trims the 'nonce' string from a payload dictionary.

methods.name: waitForNonce(timeoutSeconds:onTimeout:receiveNonce:)
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for a nonce value until a specified timeout, using an async timeout mechanism.
